Subject: Follow-up: PoC priorities and deployment mode

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap from our side and a few follow-ups: 

- Primary goal: evaluate inference latency and cost tradeoffs for our chat and summarization flows.
- Deployment constraints: data residency within US; SOC 2 evidence required; we prefer not to send PII to public endpoints unless encrypted.
- Traffic profile: ~200 concurrent users initially, peak bursts to 800 for short windows; average request size ~1.2k tokens.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can you outline the recommended PoC approach for Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC? Pros/cons for our profile.
2) What success criteria should we lock for the trial (latency p95, token cost, quality checks)?
3) Timeline and internal stakeholder list from our side for procurement and security review.

Attaching the notes I took. Looking for a short PoC plan we can review by early next week.

Thanks,
Alice
---

Subject: Re: Follow-up: PoC priorities and deployment mode

Hi Alice — great talking yesterday. Appreciate the clear summary.

High-level recommendation (short):
- Start with a Hosted API quick trial for 2 weeks to validate model fit and quality (fastest time-to-value).
- Parallel prep for Dedicated capacity if you confirm steady throughput and need for predictable latency / data isolation.
- Private VPC/on-prem recommended only if procurement and security require customer-managed networking or strict on-prem data residency.

Proposed PoC plan (attached: redwood_poc-plan-acme-v1.pdf):
- Week 0: Kickoff + access (API keys, allowlist) + test dataset sync
- Week 1: Integration + baseline profiling (latency p50/p95, cost per 1M tokens)
- Week 2: Load test (concurrency up to 800 burst), quality evals on 2000 prompt set, regression checks
- Success criteria (suggested): p95 inference latency < 200ms for common chat flows on Dedicated; for Hosted trial accept p95 < 350ms; end-to-end cost targets and quality thresholds (>=92% on our scoring rubric).

Stakeholders we'll need: your SRE (for allowlist/egress), security lead (SOC2 evidence request), product lead for test prompts.

Next steps: please confirm whether you want us to spin up a short Hosted trial first or prioritize provisioning Dedicated capacity. If Dedicated, procurement contact and approximate contract timeline would help.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2027-092
Doc: redwood_poc-plan-acme-v1.pdf (attached)

Best,
Ben Carter

Subject: Re: Follow-up: PoC priorities and deployment mode

Quick technical items from our infra side — will help us size Dedicated if you choose that path.

- Typical perf expectations: on Dedicated with NVidia H100 equivalent and our batching settings, p95 for 1.2k token chat is ~120-180ms depending on model and quantization. Hosted performance is similar for most workloads but subject to noisy neighbors under bursty traffic — we mitigate with autoscaling and fallback regions.
- Can you share: expected sustained qps per minute, dataset size for evaluation (number of conversations), and whether you need KV-cache persistence across sessions?
- For security/compliance: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report, network diagrams, and PRFAQ for our Private deployment. For Private VPC we'll coordinate with your cloud/network team on allowlist IPs and peering.

Thanks — Jordan
---
